reportedIssues: The pizza restaurant card shows a promotional badge reading '-0%'. A 0% discount is meaningless and looks like a data or template bug, since it advertises a discount that does not exist.

The light gray secondary text has low contrast against the white and light backgrounds. This affects the delivery fee lines under the 'Fastest near you' cards, the meta line under Tokumaru Ramen Bar, and the search placeholder.
The '15–25 min' time pill on the Green Bowl Poké card sits over the plate image and slightly overlaps its edge. Its position looks inconsistent with the pills on the other cards.

The heart (favorite) icon on the dark food images has no visible contrast background on the ramen card. The pale green 'Order now' promo text and the secondary text on the green banner may also be weak in contrast.
